name: SSII
description: SS Innovations International, Inc. (SSII) is a surgical robotics company founded by cardiac surgeon Dr. Sudhir Srivastava and headquartered in Gurugram, India. The company develops and manufactures the [SSI Mantra](/robot/ssii_mantra) modular multi-cart teleoperated surgical robotic system for cardiothoracic and general minimally invasive surgery.
